title.narrative: Kitui Food Security Project: Mitigating Impact of Economic downturn

description.narrative:
This project falls within the DFID funded Food Security Project which aims to mitigate the impact of economic downturn for poor and marginalised people in Kenya and Zimabwe through supporting interventions that increase agricultural production and access to food. Kenya has been selected because the economic downturn and recurrent droughts has resulted in increasing cost of agricultural inputs and food stuffs which has in turn exacerbated an already fragile food security situation. In Kenya, the project will be implemented by two of CAFOD’s partners, the Diocese of Isiolo and Diocese of Kitui.
In Kitui, this additional funding will expand on and complement ongoing work under the East Africa Sustainable Livelihoods and DRR programme. This project will therefore support farmers in Kitui Diocese through voucher for work interventions to construct soil and water conservation structures on their farms and also through construction of metal silos for use by communities for grain storage. It is hoped that this will increase agricultural productivity, improve post harvest management and availability of food during the drought period. The voucher for work intervention will also enable farmers to earn money which they can use on their priority needs including agricultural inputs. Local communities will be mobilized to engage in these activities.
As the current programmes are funded directly by CAFOD, specific activities have been earmarked for these additional funds from DFID.
